asidePark.hi: {aside} ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh kon wala kaam khatam ho jaaye.

asidePark.hi: Mazedaar, {aside} ki baat hum zaroor karenge, bas thodi der mein.
asidePark.en: Fun, we will surely talk about {aside}, just in a little while.

asideReturn.hi: {aside} mein kaunsi cheez khulti aur band hoti hai?
{aside} wali baat batao na, tumne pehli baar kab kiya?

hindiSwitch.hi: Achha, yeh baat Hindi mein kehti hoon.
hindiSwitch.en: Okay, let me put this in English.

hindiSwitch.hi: Bilkul, ab yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon.
hindiSwitch.en: Of course, I'll say this in English.

hindiSwitch.hi: Theek hai, main yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon.

askAgain.hi: Ek baar aur bolo, main sun rahi hoon.
askAgain.en: Say it once more, I'm listening.

hook.convey: two straight lines leaving one point make an angle → the shared point = vertex, the two lines = arms; a drawing of two lines from one dot, a wicket-keeper with lines to the bowler and to slip

use.hi: Drawing sheet par ek point lagao aur usi point se do seedhi lines alag-alag disha mein kheencho. Yeh ek angle hai: point uska vertex hai aur dono lines uski arms.
use.en: Put a dot on a drawing sheet and draw two straight lines from that same dot in different directions. That is an angle: the dot is its vertex and the two lines are its arms.

use.hi: Cricket ground par wicket-keeper point W par khada hai. W se ek seedhi line bowler tak aur ek slip fielder tak kheencho, toh W par ek angle banta hai, aur W uska vertex hai.
use.en: On a cricket ground the wicket-keeper stands at point W. Draw one straight line from W to the bowler and one to the slip fielder, and an angle forms at W, with W as its vertex.

explain.convey: angle = two rays starting from the same point; that point = vertex; each ray = an arm, named from the vertex outwards (ray OA); the second arm gets its own point and its name starts at O too

point.hi: Yeh ek angle hai. Isme do rays ek hi point se shuru hoti hain, yahan point O se. O is angle ka vertex hai. Neeche wali ray O se A ki taraf jaati hai, yeh ray OA hai, angle ki ek arm. Upar wali ray angle ki doosri arm hai.
point.en: This is an angle. In it two rays start from the same point, here point O. O is the vertex of this angle. The lower ray goes from O towards A; it is ray OA, one arm of the angle. The upper ray is the other arm.

prompt.hi: Upar wali arm par ek point B hai. Us arm ka naam kya hoga: ray OB ya ray BO?
prompt.en: There is a point B on the upper arm. What is that arm's name: ray OB or ray BO?

why.hi: yeh arm vertex O se B ki taraf jaati hai, aur ray ke naam mein shuru wala point pehle aata hai
why.en: this arm starts at the vertex O and goes towards B, and a ray's name begins with its starting point

simpler.hi: Angle mein do rays ek hi point se shuru hoti hain, woh point vertex hai, yahan O. Ray ke naam mein pehle vertex aata hai, jaise ray OA.
simpler.en: In an angle two rays start from the same point, the vertex, here O. A ray's name starts with the vertex, like ray OA.

explain.convey: three-letter name: a point on one arm, the VERTEX IN THE MIDDLE, a point on the other arm → angle ABC = angle CBA; any point on an arm can stand for it, the vertex letter never moves

point.hi: Is angle ka vertex B hai. Neeche wali arm par point C hai aur upar wali arm par point A. Teen letters ke naam mein vertex hamesha beech mein aata hai: angle ABC, ya ulta padho toh angle CBA. Dono naam isi ek angle ke hain.
point.en: The vertex of this angle is B. Point C is on the lower arm and point A is on the upper arm. In a three-letter name the vertex always comes in the middle: angle ABC, or read backwards, angle CBA. Both names belong to this one angle.

prompt.hi: Upar wali arm par, A se aage, ek aur point D hai. D aur C lekar is angle ka naam kya hoga?
prompt.en: On the upper arm, beyond A, there is another point D. Using D and C, what is this angle's name?

why.hi: D upar wali arm par hai aur C neeche wali par, aur vertex B beech mein aata hai
why.en: D is on the upper arm and C on the lower one, with the vertex B in the middle

simpler.hi: Teen letters ke naam mein vertex B hamesha beech mein aata hai. Pehle ek arm ka point, phir B, phir doosri arm ka point, jaise angle ABC.
simpler.en: In a three-letter name the vertex B always sits in the middle. First a point on one arm, then B, then a point on the other arm, like angle ABC.

problem.hi: School ke playground mein Anjali point T par khadi hai, Ravi point R par aur Sonu point S par. Anjali ke paas se do seedhi rassiyan nikalti hain: ek Ravi tak jaati hai aur ek Sonu tak. Rassiyon se T par jo angle banta hai, uska vertex aur arms batao, aur teen letters mein uske do sahi naam likho.
problem.en: In the school playground Anjali stands at point T, Ravi at point R and Sonu at point S. Two straight ropes start from Anjali: one goes to Ravi and one to Sonu. For the angle the ropes make at T, give its vertex and arms, and write two correct three-letter names for it.

simpler.hi: Anjali T par, Ravi R par aur Sonu S par khadi hain. T se do seedhi rassiyan R aur S tak jaati hain. T par bane angle ka vertex, arms aur do naam chahiye.
simpler.en: Anjali stands at T, Ravi at R and Sonu at S. Two straight ropes go from T to R and to S. We need the vertex, the arms and two names of the angle made at T.

givens.hi: dono rassiyan T se shuru hoti hain, ek R tak aur ek S tak jaati hai
givens.en: both ropes start at T, one going to R and one to S

find.hi: angle ka vertex, uski do arms, aur teen letters wale do sahi naam
find.en: the vertex, the two arms, and two correct three-letter names of the angle

do.hi: Dekho dono rassiyan kis point se shuru hoti hain
do.en: See which point both ropes start from

why.hi: dono rassiyan Anjali ke paas, point T se nikalti hain
why.en: both ropes leave from Anjali, at point T

simpler.hi: Dono rassiyan Anjali ke paas, point T se nikalti hain. Jahan se dono shuru hoti hain, wahi vertex hai.
simpler.en: Both ropes leave from Anjali, at point T. Where both start is the vertex.

do.hi: Vertex se baaki do points ki taraf jaati rays lo
do.en: Take the rays from the vertex towards the other two points

steps.result: arms = ray TR aur ray TS

why.hi: har arm vertex se shuru hoti hai
why.en: every arm starts at the vertex

simpler.hi: Har arm vertex T se shuru hoti hai. Ek arm R ki taraf jaati hai aur ek S ki taraf, toh ray TR aur ray TS.
simpler.en: Every arm starts at the vertex T. One arm goes towards R and one towards S, so ray TR and ray TS.

do.hi: Naam likho: ek arm ka point, beech mein vertex, phir doosri arm ka point
do.en: Write the name: a point on one arm, the vertex in the middle, then a point on the other arm

why.hi: vertex ka letter hamesha beech mein aata hai
why.en: the vertex letter always comes in the middle

simpler.hi: Vertex T ko beech mein rakho. Ek taraf R aur doosri taraf S likho, toh angle RTS bana.
simpler.en: Keep the vertex T in the middle. Write R on one side and S on the other, giving angle RTS.

prompt.hi: Ab arms wale do letters ki jagah aapas mein badlo, vertex beech mein hi rakho. Is angle ka doosra sahi naam kya hai?
prompt.en: Now swap the two arm letters and keep the vertex in the middle. What is the angle's other correct name?

simpler.hi: T beech mein hi rahega. Bas R aur S ki jagah aapas mein badal do.
simpler.en: Keep T in the middle. Just swap the places of R and S.

why.hi: rassiyan T se nikalti hain, toh T beech mein rehta hai aur sirf R aur S ki jagah badalti hai
why.en: the ropes start at T, so T stays in the middle and only R and S swap places

answer.hi: vertex T hai, arms ray TR aur ray TS hain, aur angle ke naam angle RTS aur angle STR hain
answer.en: the vertex is T, the arms are ray TR and ray TS, and the angle is named angle RTS or angle STR

why.hi: angle ek point se nikalti do rays se banta hai; naam mein vertex beech mein, sirf arms ke letters badalte hain
why.en: an angle is two rays from one point; in its name the vertex stays in the middle, only arm letters swap

prompt.hi: Angle PQR mein vertex kaunsa point hai?
prompt.en: In angle PQR, which point is the vertex?

why.hi: angle PQR ke naam mein beech wala letter Q hai, aur vertex beech mein hi likha jaata hai
why.en: Q is the middle letter of angle PQR, and the vertex is always written in the middle

simpler.hi: Teen letters wale angle ke naam mein vertex hamesha beech wala letter hota hai. Angle PQR ka beech wala letter dekho.
simpler.en: In a three-letter angle name the vertex is always the middle letter. Look at the middle letter of angle PQR.

prompt.hi: Is angle ka vertex B hai, aur arms A aur C ki taraf jaati hain. Sahi naam kaunsa hai: angle BAC ya angle ABC?
prompt.en: This angle's vertex is B, and its arms go towards A and C. Which name is correct: angle BAC or angle ABC?

why.hi: vertex B hai, toh B beech mein aata hai, A aur C kinaron par
why.en: the vertex is B, so B goes in the middle, with A and C at the ends

simpler.hi: B vertex hai, toh naam mein B beech mein aana chahiye. Dono naamon mein dekho B kahan baitha hai.
simpler.en: B is the vertex, so B must be in the middle of the name. See where B sits in each name.

prompt.hi: Ghadi ki dono suiyan centre O se nikalti hain: ek point H tak, ek point M tak. Suiyon ke beech ke angle ka teen letters wala naam kya hai?
prompt.en: Both hands of a clock start at the centre O: one goes to point H, one to point M. What is the three-letter name of the angle between the hands?

why.hi: dono suiyan O se nikalti hain, toh vertex O beech mein aata hai, H aur M kinaron par
why.en: both hands start at O, so the vertex O goes in the middle, with H and M at the ends

simpler.hi: Dono suiyan O se nikalti hain, toh O vertex hai. Naam mein vertex hamesha beech mein aata hai.
simpler.en: Both hands start at O, so O is the vertex. The vertex always goes in the middle of the name.

ladder.why: first straight use: read the vertex off a three-letter name (the middle letter)
choose between two names: the shared starting point of the beams goes in the middle
build the three-letter name from a map: paths from a gate → gate letter in the middle
from name to drawing: where the arc goes (the vertex) and which rays are the arms
three tracks from one junction → spot which names show the same angle (outer letters swapped)

remediation.move: name card with three slots: the vertex letter goes ONLY in the middle slot, the arm letters in the end slots (either way round); the little arc also sits at the vertex

say.hi: Socho ek angle ka vertex K hai, aur arms J aur L ki taraf jaati hain. Naam ke teen khaane socho: K sirf beech wale khaane mein, J aur L kinaron par. Isliye naam angle JKL hai, ya angle LKJ.
say.en: Picture an angle with vertex K and arms going towards J and L. Think of three slots for the name: K goes only in the middle slot, J and L at the ends. So the name is angle JKL, or angle LKJ.

simpler.hi: Vertex wala letter hamesha beech mein jaata hai. Baaki do letter kinaron par, kisi bhi kram mein.
simpler.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle. The other two go at the ends, in either order.

prompt.hi: Vertex N hai, arms M aur P ki taraf hain. Sahi naam kaunsa hai: angle NMP ya angle MNP?
prompt.en: The vertex is N, and the arms go towards M and P. Which name is correct: angle NMP or angle MNP?

why.hi: vertex N hai, toh N beech mein aata hai, M aur P kinaron par
why.en: the vertex is N, so N goes in the middle, with M and P at the ends

simpler.hi: N vertex hai, toh naam mein N beech mein aana chahiye. Dono naamon mein dekho N kahan baitha hai.
simpler.en: N is the vertex, so N must sit in the middle of the name. See where N is in each name.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab humein angle ke hisse aur uska naam pata hai. Agle hisse mein dekhenge ki angle chhota ya bada kis cheez se hota hai: ghumaav se.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we know the parts of an angle and its name. In the next part we will see what makes an angle small or big: the turn.

simpler.hi: Ab dekhenge ki angle chhota ya bada kis cheez se hota hai. Board par angle A aur angle B khule hue hain.
simpler.en: Now we see what makes an angle small or big. On the board angle A and angle B are opened out.

hook.convey: an angle is an amount of turn: a bat swinging from the shoulder, a bus turning right (quarter turn) or taking a U-turn (half turn) → more turn = bigger angle

use.hi: Batting karte waqt bat kandhe ke paas se ghoomta hai. Bat thoda ghooma toh chhota angle banta hai, zyada ghooma toh bada angle.
use.en: When batting, the bat turns about the shoulder. If the bat turns a little the angle is small; if it turns a lot the angle is big.

use.hi: Bus chauraahe par right mudti hai toh woh ek quarter turn ghoomti hai. U-turn le toh aadha chakkar ghoomti hai, yaani do quarter turn.
use.en: When a bus turns right at a crossing it turns a quarter turn. If it takes a U-turn it turns half a turn, that is two quarter turns.

explain.convey: angle = amount of turn: both arms start together, one arm turns about the vertex (like a door on its hinge) → the further it turns, the bigger the angle; the board animates each second arm turning open

point.hi: Angle ek ghumaav hai. Pehle dono arms ek saath hoti hain, phir ek arm vertex par ghoomkar khulti hai, jaise darwaza apne kabze par ghoomta hai. Arm jitni zyada ghoomi, angle utna bada. Board par angle A aur angle B dono aise hi khule hain.
point.en: An angle is a turn. First both arms lie together, then one arm turns open about the vertex, like a door turning on its hinge. The more the arm turns, the bigger the angle. On the board, angle A and angle B have both opened this way.

prompt.hi: Board par kis angle ki doosri arm zyada ghoomi hai, toh kaunsa angle bada hai: A ya B?
prompt.en: On the board, whose second arm has turned more, so which angle is bigger: A or B?

why.hi: board par angle B ki doosri arm angle A ki doosri arm se kahin zyada ghoomkar khuli hai
why.en: on the board angle B's second arm has turned open much further than angle A's

simpler.hi: Angle ek ghumaav hai, jaise darwaza kabze par ghoomkar khulta hai. Arm jitni zyada ghoomi, angle utna bada.
simpler.en: An angle is a turn, like a door turning open on its hinge. The more the arm turns, the bigger the angle.

explain.convey: turns on a clock: one hand on 12, the other turns from 12 → to 3 = quarter turn, to 6 = half turn, back to 12 = full turn; the child turns the half turn into quarter turns

point.hi: Ghadi mein minute wali sui 12 par hai. Ghante wali sui 12 se ghoomkar 3 par pahunche, toh yeh poore chakkar ka chautha hissa hai, quarter turn. 6 par pahunche toh aadha chakkar. Aur ghoomkar wapas 12 par aaye toh poora chakkar.
point.en: On a clock the minute hand is on 12. If the hour hand turns from 12 to 3, that is a quarter of a full turn, a quarter turn. If it reaches 6, that is a half turn. And if it turns all the way back to 12, that is a full turn.

prompt.hi: 12 se 6 tak ka aadha chakkar kitne quarter turn ke barabar hai?
prompt.en: The half turn from 12 to 6 equals how many quarter turns?

why.hi: 12 se 3 ek quarter turn hai aur 3 se 6 doosra, yaani 2 quarter turn
why.en: 12 to 3 is one quarter turn and 3 to 6 is another, so 2 quarter turns

simpler.hi: Sui 12 se 3 tak ghoome toh quarter turn, yaani chakkar ka chautha hissa. 12 se 6 tak aadha chakkar, aur wapas 12 tak poora chakkar.
simpler.en: A hand turning from 12 to 3 makes a quarter turn, a fourth of the way round. 12 to 6 is a half turn, and back to 12 is a full turn.

explain.convey: a full turn that ends where it began is NOT zero turn: a fan blade from the window, once round, back at the window = four quarter turns; the angle is the turn swept, not the end position

point.hi: Ceiling fan ka blade khidki ki taraf hai. Woh ghoomta hai aur ek poora chakkar lagakar phir khidki ki taraf aakar rukta hai. Blade wahin ruka jahan se chala tha, phir bhi woh chaar quarter turn ghooma. Angle utna hota hai jitna ghoomna hua, sirf aakhri jagah se nahi.
point.en: A ceiling fan blade points at the window. It turns, goes once all the way round and stops pointing at the window again. The blade stopped where it started, yet it turned four quarter turns. The angle is how much turning happened, not just where it ended.

prompt.hi: Yahi blade khidki se chalkar do poore chakkar ghoome aur phir khidki par ruke, toh woh kitne quarter turn ghooma?
prompt.en: If this same blade starts at the window, turns two full turns and stops at the window, how many quarter turns did it turn?

why.hi: har poora chakkar 4 quarter turn hai, aur 2 × 4 = 8
why.en: each full turn is 4 quarter turns, and 2 × 4 = 8

simpler.hi: Blade ek poora chakkar ghoomkar wahin ruka jahan se chala tha. Phir bhi woh chaar quarter turn ghooma, kyunki angle ghoomne se naapte hain.
simpler.en: The blade went once all the way round and stopped where it started. Still it turned four quarter turns, because an angle measures the turning.

problem.hi: Ghadi mein 2 baje aur 4 baje, dono samay minute wali sui 12 par hoti hai. Kis samay suiyon ke beech ka angle bada hota hai?
problem.en: On a clock at 2 o'clock and at 4 o'clock, the minute hand is on 12 both times. At which time is the angle between the hands bigger?

simpler.hi: Ghadi mein do samay hain, 2 baje aur 4 baje. Dono mein minute wali sui 12 par hai. Dekhna hai kis samay suiyon ke beech ka angle bada hai.
simpler.en: A clock shows two times, 2 o'clock and 4 o'clock. In both, the minute hand is on 12. We need to see at which time the angle between the hands is bigger.

givens.hi: 2 baje ghante wali sui 2 par hai, 4 baje 4 par, aur minute wali sui dono baar 12 par
givens.en: at 2 o'clock the hour hand is on 2, at 4 o'clock on 4, and the minute hand is on 12 both times

find.hi: kis samay suiyon ke beech ka angle bada hai
find.en: at which time the angle between the hands is bigger

do.hi: Dono samay minute wali sui 12 par hai, use dono angles ki pehli arm lo
do.en: At both times the minute hand is on 12; take it as the first arm of both angles

steps.result: pehli arm dono mein 12 ki taraf

why.hi: dono ghumaav ek hi arm se shuru hon tabhi unki tulna theek hoti hai
why.en: two turns can be compared fairly only when they start from the same arm

simpler.hi: Dono samay minute wali sui 12 par hai. Isliye dono angles ki pehli arm ek hi hai, ab tulna theek hogi.
simpler.en: At both times the minute hand is on 12. So both angles share the same first arm, and the comparison is fair.

do.hi: 2 baje ghante wali sui 12 se kahan tak ghoomi, dekho
do.en: See how far the hour hand has turned from 12 at 2 o'clock

why.hi: sui 12 se 1 tak, phir 1 se 2 tak ghoomi
why.en: the hand turned from 12 to 1, then from 1 to 2

simpler.hi: 2 baje ghante wali sui 12 se chalkar 2 par ruki. Itna hi uska ghumaav hai.
simpler.en: At 2 o'clock the hour hand went from 12 and stopped on 2. That is how far it turned.

do.hi: Ab 4 baje ke liye bhi wahi dekho
do.en: Now see the same for 4 o'clock

why.hi: sui 12 se 1, 2, 3 ko paar karke 4 tak ghoomi
why.en: the hand turned from 12 past 1, 2 and 3 to 4

simpler.hi: 4 baje ghante wali sui 12 se chalkar 4 par ruki. Yeh 2 baje se zyada door hai.
simpler.en: At 4 o'clock the hour hand went from 12 and stopped on 4. That is further than at 2 o'clock.

prompt.hi: Ab dono ghumaav milao. Kis samay suiyon ke beech ka angle bada hai: 2 baje ya 4 baje?
prompt.en: Now compare the two turns. At which time is the angle between the hands bigger: 2 o'clock or 4 o'clock?

simpler.hi: Jis samay sui 12 se zyada door tak ghoomi, us samay angle bada hai. Dono samay ka ghumaav milaao.
simpler.en: At the time the hand turned further from 12, the angle is bigger. Compare the turns at the two times.

why.hi: 4 baje sui 12 se 4 tak ghoomi, 2 baje sirf 2 tak, toh 4 baje ka ghumaav zyada hai
why.en: at 4 o'clock the hand turned from 12 to 4, at 2 only to 2, so the turn at 4 is bigger

answer.hi: 4 baje suiyon ke beech ka angle bada hai
answer.en: the angle between the hands is bigger at 4 o'clock

why.hi: dono angle 12 wali arm se shuru hote hain, aur 4 baje sui 4 tak ghoomi, 2 baje sirf 2 tak
why.en: both angles start from the arm on 12; the hand reached 4 at 4 o'clock, only 2 at 2 o'clock

prompt.hi: Minute wali sui 12 se chalkar ek poora chakkar ghoomti hai, aur phir aage 9 tak jaati hai. Woh kul kitne quarter turn ghoomi?
prompt.en: The minute hand starts at 12, turns one full turn and then goes on to 9. How many quarter turns did it turn in all?

why.hi: poora chakkar 4 quarter turn hai, phir 12 se 9 tak 3 aur, toh 4 + 3 = 7
why.en: a full turn is 4 quarter turns, then 12 to 9 is 3 more, so 4 + 3 = 7

simpler.hi: Pehle poore chakkar ke quarter turn gino. Phir 12 se 9 tak ke quarter turn alag se gino, aur dono jodo.
simpler.en: First count the quarter turns in the full turn. Then count the quarter turns from 12 to 9 separately, and add them.

prompt.hi: Sui X 12 se seedha 3 tak ghoomi. Sui Y 12 se ek poora chakkar lagakar phir 3 tak ghoomi. Kya dono ka ghumaav barabar hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Hand X turned straight from 12 to 3. Hand Y went one full turn from 12 and then on to 3. Have both turned the same amount, yes or no?

why.hi: X sirf ek quarter turn ghoomi, par Y ek poora chakkar aur phir ek quarter turn ghoomi
why.en: X turned just one quarter turn, but Y turned a full turn and then one quarter turn more

simpler.hi: X sirf 12 se 3 tak ghoomi. Y pehle poora chakkar ghoomi aur phir 3 tak gayi, toh Y ka ghumaav alag se dekho.
simpler.en: X turned only from 12 to 3. Y first turned a full turn and then went on to 3, so look at Y's turning separately.

ladder.why: clock hands at 3 and at 6: quarter turn vs half turn → the half turn is bigger
a direction arrow turning from north to east vs to south → compare the turn, not the end direction
right turn vs U-turn at a crossing → which is bigger and how many times (2)

remediation.move: pointer that drags a ribbon behind it: start at 12, turn past 3, 6, 9 back to 12 → count the quarter turns passed (1, 2, 3, 4) → same end position, but the ribbon shows a whole circle swept → angle = turn swept, not end position

say.hi: Sui ke peechhe ek ribbon socho jo ghoomte hue jagah rang deta hai. Sui 12 se 3, 6, 9 hokar wapas 12 par aaye, toh ribbon har taraf rang deta hai. Sui wahin ruki, par chaar quarter turn ghoomi.
say.en: Imagine a ribbon behind the hand that colours the space as it turns. If the hand goes from 12 past 3, 6, 9 back to 12, the ribbon colours all the way round. It stopped where it started, but turned four quarter turns.

simpler.hi: Ruki kahan, yeh mat dekho. Ghoomte hue sui kitne quarter turn chali, woh gino.
simpler.en: Do not look at where it stopped. Count how many quarter turns the hand went through while turning.

prompt.hi: Sui 12 se ek poora chakkar lagakar phir 3 tak gayi. Kul kitne quarter turn hue?
prompt.en: A hand went one full turn from 12 and then on to 3. How many quarter turns is that in all?

why.hi: poora chakkar 4 quarter turn hai, phir 12 se 3 ek aur, toh 4 + 1 = 5
why.en: a full turn is 4 quarter turns, then 12 to 3 is one more, so 4 + 1 = 5

simpler.hi: Poora chakkar chaar quarter turn hai. 12 se 3 tak ek quarter turn aur hai, dono jodo.
simpler.en: A full turn is four quarter turns. 12 to 3 is one more quarter turn; add them.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ghumaav jitna zyada, angle utna bada. Agle hisse mein do angles, jaise angle P aur angle Q, ko ek doosre par rakhkar milaana seekhenge.
bridgeToNext.en: The more the turn, the bigger the angle. In the next part we will learn to compare two angles, like angle P and angle Q, by placing one on the other.

simpler.hi: Ab do angles ko ek doosre par rakhkar milaana seekhenge. Board par angle P aur angle Q hain.
simpler.en: Now we learn to compare two angles by placing one on the other. On the board there are angle P and angle Q.

hook.convey: the same opening can have short or long arms: a small and a big roti each shared into 4 equal parts → each corner at the centre is a quarter turn; the same angle drawn small and drawn with long lines → only the turn counts

use.hi: Ek chhoti roti aur ek badi roti, dono ke chaar barabar hisse banao. Har hisse ka beech wala kona ek quarter turn hai, roti chhoti ho ya badi.
use.en: Take a small roti and a big roti and make four equal parts of each. The corner of every part at the centre is a quarter turn, whether the roti is small or big.

use.hi: Drawing mein ek angle chhoti lines se banao aur wahi angle bade kagaz par lambi lines se. Lines lambi ho gayi, par khulapan wahi raha.
use.en: In a drawing, make an angle with short lines and the same angle on a big sheet with long lines. The lines got longer, but the opening stayed the same.

explain.convey: compare by superposing: copy one angle on tracing paper → vertex on vertex, one arm on one arm → look at the second arms: the one turned further out belongs to the bigger angle

mustSay.hi: ek arm ke upar ek arm

point.hi: Do angles milaane ke liye ek angle ki copy tracing paper par banao. Phir copy ka vertex doosre angle ke vertex par rakho, yaani vertex par vertex, aur ek arm ke upar ek arm. Ab doosri arm dekho: jiski doosri arm zyada ghoomi hui, bahar ki taraf hai, woh angle bada hai. Board par angle P aur angle Q hain.
point.en: To compare two angles, copy one angle on tracing paper. Then put the copy's vertex on the other angle's vertex, vertex on vertex, and one arm on one arm. Now look at the second arm: the angle whose second arm has turned further, lying outside, is bigger. On the board are angle P and angle Q.

prompt.hi: Angle P ki copy angle Q par aise hi rakho. Kiski doosri arm bahar rahegi, yaani kaunsa angle bada hai: P ya Q?
prompt.en: Place a copy of angle P on angle Q this way. Whose second arm stays outside, that is, which angle is bigger: P or Q?

why.hi: Q ki doosri arm P ki doosri arm se zyada ghoomi hai, toh copy rakhne par Q ki arm bahar rehti hai
why.en: angle Q's second arm has turned further than angle P's, so with the copy laid on, Q's arm stays outside

simpler.hi: Ek angle ki copy doosre par rakho: vertex par vertex, aur ek arm par ek arm. Jiski doosri arm bahar ki taraf rahe, woh angle bada hai.
simpler.en: Put a copy of one angle on the other: vertex on vertex, and one arm on one arm. The angle whose second arm lies outside is bigger.

explain.convey: arm length is not the angle: an arm is a ray that goes on forever, the paper shows only a piece of it → drawing the arms longer keeps their directions → the turn, and so the angle, is unchanged

point.hi: Board par angle A aur angle B ek jitne khule hain. Arm ek ray hai jo aage chalti hi jaati hai; kagaz par hum uska sirf ek hissa banaate hain. Isliye arms ki lambai se angle nahi badalta. Angle sirf ghumaav se badalta hai.
point.en: On the board angle A and angle B are opened the same amount. An arm is a ray that goes on and on; on paper we draw only a piece of it. So the length of the arms does not change the angle. Only the turn changes the angle.

prompt.hi: Ab angle B ki dono arms ko pencil se aur aage tak badha do. Ab angle B, angle A se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?
prompt.en: Now extend both arms of angle B further with a pencil. Is angle B now bigger than angle A, smaller, or equal?

why.hi: arms badhane se sirf lakeerein lambi hui, B ka ghumaav utna hi raha jitna A ka
why.en: extending the arms only made the lines longer; B's turn stayed the same as A's

simpler.hi: Arm ek ray hai jo aage chalti rehti hai, kaagaz par uska sirf ek hissa banta hai. Isliye arms lambi karne se angle nahi badalta, sirf ghumaav se badalta hai.
simpler.en: An arm is a ray that goes on and on; on paper we draw only a piece. So longer arms do not change an angle; only the turn does.

explain.convey: the little arc at the vertex is only a mark that says which angle we mean, like a label → a bigger arc does not move the arms → the angle stays the same; the wider-open angle stays bigger whatever arcs are drawn

point.hi: Vertex ke paas jo chhota arc lagate hain, woh sirf nishaan hai. Woh batata hai ki hum kaunsa angle dekh rahe hain, jaise naam ka label. Arc chhota ho ya bada, arms wahin rehti hain, toh angle bhi wahi rehta hai. Board par angle M aur angle N hain.
point.en: The little arc we put near the vertex is only a mark. It tells which angle we are looking at, like a name label. Whether the arc is small or big, the arms stay where they are, so the angle stays the same too. On the board are angle M and angle N.

prompt.hi: Ab angle M par bahut bada arc banao aur angle N par chhota sa. Ab kaunsa angle bada hai: M ya N?
prompt.en: Now draw a very big arc on angle M and a tiny one on angle N. Which angle is bigger now: M or N?

why.hi: arc ka size arms ko nahi hilata, aur N ki arms M ki arms se zyada khuli hain
why.en: the size of an arc does not move the arms, and N's arms are open wider than M's

simpler.hi: Vertex ke paas ka arc sirf ek nishaan hai, jaise naam ka label. Arc chhota ho ya bada, arms wahin rehti hain, toh angle nahi badalta.
simpler.en: The arc near the vertex is only a mark, like a name label. Small arc or big, the arms stay put, so the angle does not change.

problem.hi: Ritu cardboard se do angles banati hai. Angle ABC ki arms 9 cm lambi hain aur angle PQR ki arms 4 cm. Woh angle PQR ko angle ABC par aise rakhti hai ki Q, B par aaye aur arm QP, arm BA ke upar. Tab arm QR, arm BC se bhi aage bahar padti hai. Kaunsa angle bada hai?
problem.en: Ritu makes two angles from cardboard. Angle ABC has arms 9 cm long and angle PQR has arms 4 cm long. She places angle PQR on angle ABC so that Q sits on B and arm QP lies along arm BA. Then arm QR lies outside, beyond arm BC. Which angle is bigger?

simpler.hi: Ritu ne angle PQR ko angle ABC par rakha, Q ko B par aur arm QP ko arm BA par. Arm QR, arm BC se bahar padti hai. Kaunsa angle bada hai, yeh dekhna hai.
simpler.en: Ritu placed angle PQR on angle ABC, with Q on B and arm QP along arm BA. Arm QR lies outside arm BC. We need to see which angle is bigger.

givens.hi: angle ABC ki arms 9 cm aur angle PQR ki 4 cm hain; Q, B par aur QP, BA par hai, aur QR, BC ke bahar padti hai
givens.en: angle ABC has 9 cm arms and angle PQR 4 cm arms; Q is on B, QP lies along BA, and QR lies outside, beyond BC

find.en: the bigger of the two angles

do.hi: Pehle vertex milao: Q ko B par rakho
do.en: First match the vertices: put Q on B

steps.result: dono ka vertex ek hi jagah

why.hi: vertex mile bina do ghumaav ki tulna nahi ho sakti
why.en: two turns cannot be compared until the vertices match

simpler.hi: Pehle Q ko B par rakho, taaki dono angle ek hi vertex se shuru hon. Vertex mile bina tulna nahi ho sakti.
simpler.en: First put Q on B, so both angles start from one vertex. Without matching vertices we cannot compare.

do.hi: Ab ek arm milao: QP ko BA ke upar rakho
do.en: Now match one arm: lay QP along BA

steps.result: pehli arm dono ki ek hi line par

why.hi: ab dono ghumaav ek hi arm se shuru hote hain
why.en: now both turns start from the same arm

simpler.hi: Ab QP ko BA ke upar rakho. Isse dono ghumaav ek hi arm se shuru hote hain.
simpler.en: Now lay QP along BA. Then both turns start from the same arm.

do.hi: Doosri arms dekho: QR, BC se bhi aage bahar hai
do.en: Look at the second arms: QR lies outside, beyond BC

why.hi: QR angle ABC ke khulepan se bahar nikal jaati hai
why.en: QR goes outside the opening of angle ABC

simpler.hi: Doosri arm QR, BC se bhi aage bahar padti hai. Matlab QR zyada ghoomi hai.
simpler.en: The second arm QR lies outside, beyond BC. That means QR has turned more.

prompt.hi: Arms ki lambai 4 cm aur 9 cm hai, par woh ghumaav ka hissa nahi hai. Toh kaunsa angle bada hai: angle ABC ya angle PQR?
prompt.en: The arms are 4 cm and 9 cm long, but that is not part of the turn. So which angle is bigger: angle ABC or angle PQR?

simpler.hi: Arms 4 cm hon ya 9 cm, isse angle nahi badalta. Dekho kiski doosri arm zyada ghoomi hai, wahi angle bada hai.
simpler.en: Whether the arms are 4 cm or 9 cm does not change the angle. See whose second arm turned more; that angle is bigger.

why.hi: QR, angle ABC ki arm BC ke bahar tak ghoomi, toh angle PQR bada hai; arms ki lambai se fark nahi
why.en: QR turned beyond BC, an arm of angle ABC, so angle PQR is bigger; arm length makes no difference

answer.hi: angle PQR bada hai, jabki uski arms chhoti hain
answer.en: angle PQR is bigger, even though its arms are shorter

why.hi: vertex aur ek arm milaane par jiski doosri arm zyada ghoomi ho woh bada hai; arms ki lambai ghumaav nahi badalti
why.en: with vertex and one arm matched, the angle whose second arm turned further is bigger; arm length does not change the turn

prompt.hi: Board ke angle X aur angle Y ko ek doosre par rakhne par vertex aur dono arms mil jaati hain. Ab Y ki arms 8 cm tak lambi kar do. Kaunsa bada hai: X, Y, ya dono barabar?
prompt.en: When angle X and angle Y on the board are placed one on the other, the vertex and both arms match. Now make Y's arms 8 cm long. Which is bigger: X, Y, or are they equal?

why.hi: X aur Y ka vertex aur dono arms milte hain, aur arms lambi karne se ghumaav nahi badalta
why.en: X and Y match at the vertex and both arms, and longer arms do not change the turn

simpler.hi: X aur Y ke vertex aur dono arms ek doosre par mil jaate hain. Arms 8 cm tak lambi karne se ghumaav nahi badalta.
simpler.en: X and Y match at the vertex and both arms. Making the arms 8 cm long does not change the turn.

prompt.hi: Board ke angle K par bada arc banao aur angle L par chhota arc. Ab kaunsa angle bada hai: K ya L?
prompt.en: Draw a big arc on angle K on the board and a small arc on angle L. Which angle is bigger now: K or L?

why.hi: L ki arms K ki arms se zyada khuli hain, aur arc ka size kuch nahi badalta
why.en: L's arms are open wider than K's, and the size of an arc changes nothing

simpler.hi: Arc sirf nishaan hai, uske size se angle nahi badalta. Board par dekho kiski arms zyada khuli hain.
simpler.en: An arc is only a mark; its size does not change the angle. Look on the board at whose arms are open wider.

prompt.hi: Angle S ki copy angle T par rakho: vertex par vertex, ek arm par ek arm. Phir S ki arms bahut lambi kar do. Kaunsa angle bada hai: S ya T?
prompt.en: Place a copy of angle S on angle T: vertex on vertex, one arm on one arm. Then make S's arms very long. Which angle is bigger: S or T?

why.hi: board par T ki doosri arm S ki doosri arm se zyada ghoomi hai, aur S ki lambi arms ghumaav nahi badaltin
why.en: on the board T's second arm has turned further than S's, and S's longer arms do not change its turn

simpler.hi: Arms lambi karne se ghumaav nahi badalta. Copy rakhkar dekho kiski doosri arm zyada ghoomi hai.
simpler.en: Longer arms do not change the turn. Lay the copy down and see whose second arm has turned more.

ladder.why: predict: same quarter-turn opening with 2 cm and 10 cm arms → equal
error-spot: a narrow angle with long arms called bigger → the wide one is bigger, only the turn counts
superposed angles whose second arms overlap but one drawing has longer arms → equal, and say why
explain in words why longer arms do not make a bigger angle (same directions, same turn)

remediation.move: angle-maker with two arms that stretch: pull the arms longer while watching the opening → the opening does not change → the turn is the angle, arm length is not

say.hi: Ek angle-maker socho jiski do pattiyan kheenchne par lambi ho jaati hain. Pattiyan lambi karo, par unke beech ka khulapan wahi rehta hai. Angle ghumaav se banta hai, arms ki lambai se nahi.
say.en: Imagine an angle-maker whose two strips get longer when you pull them. Make the strips longer, but the opening between them stays the same. An angle comes from the turn, not from the length of the arms.

simpler.hi: Angle-maker ki pattiyan lambi karo, par khulapan wahi rehta hai. Angle ghumaav se banta hai, lambai se nahi.
simpler.en: Make the angle-maker's strips longer, and the opening stays the same. An angle comes from the turn, not the length.

prompt.hi: Angle E aur angle F dono quarter turn khule hain. Ab F ki arms 10 cm tak badha do. Kaunsa bada hai: E, F, ya barabar?
prompt.en: Angles E and F are both a quarter turn. Now F's arms are made 10 cm long. Which is bigger: E, F, or equal?

why.hi: angle E aur F barabar khule hain, aur 10 cm arms se F ka ghumaav nahi badla
why.en: angles E and F are opened equally, and making F's arms 10 cm did not change its turn

simpler.hi: Dono angle quarter turn khule hain. Arms 10 cm tak lambi karne se ghumaav nahi badalta.
simpler.en: Both angles are open a quarter turn. Making the arms 10 cm long does not change the turn.

remediation.move: tracing-paper copy laid on the other angle: the arms match exactly → rub out the arc and draw a bigger one → the arms did not move → the angle did not change

say.hi: Ek angle ki copy tracing paper par banao aur doosre angle par rakho: arms bilkul mil jaati hain. Ab copy ka chhota arc mitaakar bada arc banao. Arms hili hi nahi, isliye angle bhi wahi raha.
say.en: Copy one angle on tracing paper and lay it on the other angle: the arms match exactly. Now rub out the copy's small arc and draw a big one. The arms did not move at all, so the angle stayed the same.

simpler.hi: Copy ka arc chhota ho ya bada, arms nahi hilti. Isliye angle wahi rehta hai.
simpler.en: Small arc or big arc on the copy, the arms do not move. So the angle stays the same.

prompt.hi: Angle G aur angle H ek doosre par bilkul milte hain. Ab H par bada arc banao. Kaunsa bada hai: G, H, ya barabar?
prompt.en: Angles G and H match exactly when laid one on the other. Now H gets a big arc. Which is bigger: G, H, or equal?

why.hi: G aur H bilkul milte hain, aur bada arc arms ko hilata nahi
why.en: G and H match exactly, and a big arc does not move the arms

simpler.hi: G aur H ek doosre par bilkul milte hain. Bada arc sirf nishaan hai, usse ghumaav nahi badalta.
simpler.en: G and H match exactly one on the other. A big arc is only a mark; it does not change the turn.
